messages:
Incident Bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate and latency observed in aws ap-southeast-2 region for Hosted API and multiple Dedicated pools. Rule: region-5xx-spike. Initial detection 2099991111. Severity: P1. Pager dispatched to #eng-oncall :rotating_light:
Lina O'Connor: I'm on it, taking lead. Noted errors: 502/504 spikes and tail latency > 2s on generation endpoints. Pls post any auth or cloud-control-plane errors you see.
Devon Hsu: seeing repeated STS 429\/Throttling errors in control-plane logs for ap-southeast-2: "RequestLimitExceeded" and also ELB health check fails for some instances. Dedicated pools losing backend registrations intermittently.
Priya Nair: Confirmed. From infra side: control-plane calls to AWS IAM\/STS are being rate-limited per account in ap-southeast-2. Also our observability ingestion shows backpressure — traces and logs ingesters have ~90s backlog. Observability vendor (thirdparty-monitor) returned 503s.
ObservabilityBot: Ingestion error summary: 503s to http://ingest.thirdparty-monitor.com (ap-southeast-2 endpoint). Queue size +12000, retry-4. Sample errors: "upstream connect error or disconnect".
Lina O'Connor: Impact assessment: 1) Hosted API: user-facing latency increase and failed requests for ap-southeast-2 region keys. 2) Dedicated: pools in that region experiencing elevated error rates and partial capacity loss. 3) Telemetry degraded — makes triage harder.
Marta Ruiz: Support: we already have 3 customers reporting 5xx in ap-southeast-2 via support inbox. All are on Hosted API; two are on Dedicated reserved pools. They're asking for ETA.
Devon Hsu: immediate mitigations I'm initiating: 1) engage smart routing to shift new requests from ap-southeast-2 to nearest healthy region (ap-southeast-1 / ap-northeast-1) for non-data-resident tenants 2) mark failing Dedicated pools as degraded to avoid scheduling new sessions 3) enable increased retry/backoff on STS calls where safe
Priya Nair: command to flip routing policy for ap-southeast-2 prefix (runbook snippet):
```
redwoodctl routing update --region ap-southeast-2 --policy degrade --fallback-region ap-southeast-1 --reason "region control-plane throttling"
```
I'll run with 1% traffic first then ramp to 30% if no regressions.
DeployBot: NOTE: No active deploys to ap-southeast-2 currently. Canary rollback not needed.
Lina O'Connor: @Devon, @Priya please post correlation ids and sample logs as you get them. We'll need to track customer impact and decide whether to declare incident after 15m.
Devon Hsu: sample control-plane log: "2026-03-15T03:05:12Z [sts] RequestLimitExceeded: 429 from iam.amazonaws.com, account=x123, retries=2". Also ELB health events: "Instance deregistered due to failed healthchecks (timeout)".
Priya Nair: Observability mapping: traces for generation endpoints missing spans after 03:04:50Z; logs delayed into S3 archive. We're enabling local debug logs on a handful of nodes for immediate triage.
Marta Ruiz: I'll send a brief customer-facing note to affected customers: short note, we are investigating region-level AWS throttling impacting API in ap-southeast-2; recommend switching to other region endpoints or dedicated fallback if applicable. Draft: "We're investigating elevated errors and latency in Sydney (ap-southeast-2). We're routing new traffic to nearby regions where possible and will update in 30 minutes."
Alex Chen: +1. Also flagging sales\/account teams for high-value customers in that region. We should offer credit if SLA breached.
Devon Hsu: Next step: if routing reduces errors, we'll keep degraded state until AWS resolves. If errors persist across regions, escalate to cloud support. I'm opening a support case with AWS with logs and RequestLimitExceeded traces. Case # will be posted.
Lina O'Connor: Handoff: I'm rotating off in ~20m. @Devon you'll take primary after that. Please confirm.
Devon Hsu: taking primary after 20m. Will follow up with AWS case ID and post mitigation metrics.
Priya Nair: Ran routing change: started 1% -> observed 35% reduction in 5xx within 3 minutes for routed traffic. Ramping to 25% now.
ObservabilityBot: metric snapshot: ap-southeast-2 5xx rate (root): 12.4% -> after routing partial shift: 7.9%. Ingest errors remain for telemetry; sampling now set to 0.2 to conserve pipeline.
Marta Ruiz: Notifying affected customers now (sent). I'll include suggested workaround and ETA note.
Lina O'Connor: Decision: Declaring incident P1. Postmortem lead: Devon. Communications lead: Marta. Ops lead: Priya. Timeline tracking started.
Devon Hsu: AWS support case opened: 987654321 (placeholder until case confirmed). Requested escalation for STS throttling and ELB control-plane flaps.
Priya Nair: Temporary mitigations checklist executed: routing fallback, degrade dedicated scheduling, increase client side backoff, reduce telemetry sampling. Next: determine whether we should fail open to cached model kernels for a subset of traffic to reduce control-plane calls.
Alex Chen: coordinating external comms. Draft external status page update: "We are experiencing elevated errors and latency in ap-southeast-2 due to upstream AWS control-plane and third-party telemetry ingestion issues. Traffic is being routed to healthy regions for many tenants. We are monitoring and will update every 30m."
Lina O'Connor: If anyone gets a page from customers escalate to Marta. I'm moving to incident channel and will update status every 15 minutes until handoff.
Devon Hsu: leaving a quick checklist for next on-call: 1) continue routing ramp if error rate drops; 2) monitor STS 429s; 3) coordinate with AWS case; 4) watch Dedicated pool re-registration events; 5) keep customers informed.
Marta Ruiz: Confirmed: customers acknowledged workaround; one customer requested immediate region switch — we've provided steps.
ObservabilityBot: Tracing note: sample traces resumed partially after 03:18Z for routed traffic; full ingest recovery pending vendor.
Lina O'Connor: Thanks everyone. Handoff in 18m to Devon. Will post final status before leaving.
Devon Hsu: I'll post AWS case ID and update every 10m.
Incident Bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: P1 declared 2099991300. Mitigation: routing fallback enabled, dedicated pools degraded, telemetry sampling reduced. Next update scheduled in 10 minutes.
